despair.name: Despair fill-rate probe
despair.measures: Do the V7 ladder rungs actually fill? Rests exactly 1 contract at 2/3/4/5/6¢ on markets V7 would arm, and records queue-at-placement, time-to-fill and mid markouts per order.

p8b.name: P8-CBFADE branch-B probe (RETIRED)
p8b.measures: Does a resting maker sell at 0.9500 fill? Taker-buys 1 contract of a comeback favourite at ≤0.70, then rests a post-only sell at 0.9500 until it fills or the match settles.
